title: Good Faith Estimate Service Standard — Laboratory Test Orders
content:
Good faith estimates of the self-pay price of Laboratory Test Orders follow the same three timing figures in every service class.

| Service class | Issued after the patient's request within (business days) | Issued after a self-pay collection is scheduled at least three business days ahead within (business days) | Estimate applies to a collection within (calendar days from the estimate date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Routine Clinical Testing | 3 | 1 | 90 |
| Specialty Clinical Testing | 3 | 1 | 90 |
| Esoteric Reference Testing | 3 | 1 | 90 |
| Molecular Infectious Disease Testing | 3 | 1 | 90 |
| Clinical Toxicology Testing | 3 | 1 | 90 |
| Anatomic Pathology & Cytology | 3 | 1 | 90 |
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | 3 | 1 | 90 |

**The three figures.**

1. *On request* — the business days within which a good faith estimate is issued after the patient requests one.
2. *When scheduled* — the business days within which a good faith estimate is issued once a self-pay collection is scheduled at least three business days ahead.
3. *Validity* — the calendar days from the estimate date during which the estimate applies to a collection. This is the estimate validity period of every class.

**Example (hypothetical dates).** An estimate dated 6 January applies to a collection made up to and including 6 April of the same (non-leap) year, the estimate date being day 0 and day 90 being 6 April.
